deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 27% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.9% = 10-year Treasury 4.9% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 32% last year; 31%/yr over 3 years — roughly in line with its recent growth.

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $9.0B, up 30% from a year ago — about 1.7× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $2.6B, up 14% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Stock-based pay is 30% of sales — a real cost to shareholders that cash-flow figures leave out.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 31%/yr over 3 years and 45%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today -23% vs a 5-year range of -74–-23% (median -40%): near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back).
deeper.margin_position: near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back)

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $683M to shareholders over the last 12 months ($683M buybacks + $0M dividends) = 0.6% of the company's market value. Share count up 4.2% from a year ago (stock pay outpacing buybacks — dilution).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $3.04, up 13% in 90 days (up 1% in the last 30); 2 analysts raised, 0 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $2.23, up 15% in 90 days; 1 analyst raised, 0 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By product, latest quarter vs a year earlier: Product revenue 96% of sales, up 37%; Professional services and other revenue 4% of sales, up 1%. Source: 10-Q XBRL.

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.sub: latest quarter +35% vs a year earlier · 12-month sales $5.4B
tiles.read: Latest quarter: sales up 35% vs a year earlier and speeding up (from 30% two quarters ago): demand is strengthening.
tiles.explain: Headline: sales over the last 12 months vs the 12 months before. Bars: each quarter's sales vs the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Operating margin -23%: it spends more to run the business than it earns from sales.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It kept $1.2B of cash after investment over 12 months.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: P/E isn't meaningful: earnings over the last 12 months were negative or missing.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share: how many years of today's profit you pay for.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Dec 2; analysts expect EPS of $0.60, up 71% from a year ago. It usually moves about 17% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.
